name: Post-Event Engine — M2 Post-Event Comms [LOCAL DEMO STAND-IN]

parameters.content:
## LOCAL DEMO STAND-IN
This workflow shells out to the same Python CLI scripts used by `orchestrator/run_pipeline.py` via Execute Command nodes -- it lets a judge see the pipeline DAG inside n8n's UI with zero credentials.

**It will NOT run on n8n Cloud** (Execute Command requires a self-hosted/queue-mode n8n with shell access) and it is not the production design.

Production lane: `orchestrator/n8n/cloud/master.json` -- real Webhook trigger, HTTP Request nodes to the webinar platform / Clay / HubSpot, a Code node for payload shaping, a Wait+IF approval gate, and a disabled Telegram notify.

nodes.name: M2 Comms
nodes.notes: M2 reads M1's hubspot_ready.csv -- this standalone single-module file used to hard-fail on a fresh clone if imported/run on its own instead of via master.json, since out/pipeline/m1/ would not exist yet. Self-heals: runs M1 first only if its output isn't already there, so this file is genuinely runnable standalone, not just as a step inside master.json.

parameters.command: test -f out/pipeline/m1/hubspot_ready.csv || python3 modules/m1-enrichment/enrich.py --out out/pipeline/m1; python3 modules/m2-comms/comms.py --out out/pipeline/m2 --enriched out/pipeline/m1/hubspot_ready.csv
echo '[stub] approved — would POST comms batch to HubSpot Marketing Email API here'
